source.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: tileable game PBR BASE COLOR texture, not a material sphere or scene. Create a single square 1024x1024 seamless texture of aged industrial warehouse concrete, covering about 3 metres square. Orthographic straight-on surface only, perfectly uniform diffuse shadowless lighting, no baked ambient shadows or reflections. Medium neutral warm grey cement around RGB 143 141 132, fine exposed aggregate, small pits, subtle mottling and faint worn floor abrasions, restrained low contrast. No grid, tiles, borders, large cracks, debris, painted lines, letters, logos, watermark, perspective or objects. The whole image is the flat surface. All four edges must repeat seamlessly. Realistic scale, quiet broad variation, physically plausible old public cargo terminal, not rubble. This will be used at 1K with mipmaps in Unity, with separate shader roughness and micro-normal maps.

source.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless tileable BASE COLOR texture for realistic Unity industrial environment materials. A single flat square 1024x1024 aged painted steel surface, representing one square metre, top-down orthographic with absolutely uniform shadowless diffuse lighting. Neutral light grey paint (around RGB 170,170,166) so it can be tinted blue, oxide red or ochre in engine. Most paint intact; subtle powdery coating grain, a few tiny short irregular hairline scratches and isolated pin-sized dark grey exposed steel chips, slight muted dirt variation. Restrained contrast and micro-detail, not destroyed or peeling. No large damage islands, no metal corrugation, no seams or panels, no rivets, no rust orange, no shadows, no reflections, no edges, no labels or objects. This is raw diffuse albedo surface data, not a photographed object or material sphere. All 4 edges seamlessly repeat. Industrial public cargo terminal realism. Keep distribution even so repetition is invisible from 5 metres.
